Class Toasts

java.lang.Object
com.taskflow.ui.Toasts
public final class Toasts extends Object
Shows short "toast" messages at the bottom of the window. A toast slides up, fades in, waits and fades out again. It can carry an action such as "UNDO". Only one toast is visible at a time.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Ibrahim Masood
